import JudgeProblem
-- mathgraph constructor: equality-chain

def submission : Goal := by
  intro G _ h
  intro x y z
  have p0 : (x ◇ x) = (x ◇ y) := h (x) (y)
  have p1 : (x ◇ x) = (x ◇ z) := h (x) (z)
  have p2 : (x ◇ y) = (x ◇ x) := Eq.symm p0
  have p3 : (x ◇ y) = (x ◇ z) := Eq.trans p2 p1
  exact p3
